Notes: Most disagreements were qualified labels (Partially, Barely, Yes briefly) where the coding guide requires binary yes/no; also whether a 1-month gap counts as a gap (threshold is 3 months).
Author values often restated that activity resumed without naming the trigger; resolved by citing the first post-gap commits (rewrite, build-system revival, release cycle).
Irregular/cyclical vs declining; resolved by comparing yearly commit totals, which showed sustained long-term decline.
Mechanical rule (last commit on/after 2025-04-01) left no room for disagreement.
Unlabeled merge commits were coded as Other and outranked real themes; one validator compared against the author file rather than the actual latest 10 commits.
